intent: Record which agent drafted each proposed element.

edit.summary:
I proposed two changes in the `authoring` domain. I left `delivery` alone, because elements are proposed only in `authoring`. Both proposals were accepted with 0 issues, and both are still in the `proposed` state until the owner confirms them.

- **`objects.Element`** (proposal `E-19-9a6bc307`): I added an optional string property, `drafted_by`. Everything else on the object is as it was.
- **`actions.propose_element`** (proposal `E-19-57400ee1`): I added an optional `drafted_by` param. I also added an effect that sets `target.drafted_by` from `params.drafted_by`. It runs before the existing `propose_element` kernel call, which is unchanged.

I made `drafted_by` optional, so existing callers of `propose_element` keep working. That also means an agent can leave it blank, and then the element won't show who drafted it. If the owner wants it required, that is a one-line change to the param.

The agent's name is supplied by the caller. The declaration has no verified agent identity to fill it in automatically.
